_doc: NOKEY1: the exact (stable-field) output form a real-http resolver run WITHOUT NEAR_AI_API_KEY emits: an UNSIGNED error object. No `result`, no `signing`. Shared by resolver/wasm-bin (asserts it emits this) and contracts/escrow/tests/nokey1_no_key_output.rs (feeds it to on_resolution).
reason: NEAR_AI_API_KEY is not set in the wasm's environment: the OutLayer secret was not injected. The run reads the secret stored under secrets_ref {secrets_profile, secrets_account_id} (the escrow's outlayer_config) -- bind NEAR_AI_API_KEY under THAT OutLayer account (see TESTING.md, NEAR AI key lookup).
